PR Summary by Qodo

Add done and remove commands with durable todo IDs ✨ Enhancement 🐞 Bug fix 🧪 Tests 📝 Documentation 🕐 20-40 Minutes
AI Description

>
>• Add done, remove, and list --all to manage completed items.
>• Prevent ID reuse and reject duplicate IDs in hand-edited store files.
>• Return consistent errors for invalid IDs, with CLI and store regression tests.
>
Diagram

```mermaid graph TD CLI["Todo CLI"] --> Parser["Argument parser"] --> Commands["Command handlers"] --> Store["Validated store"] --> File[("Todo JSON")] Commands --> Lookup["ID lookup"] --> Store ```
High-Level Assessment

>Extending the existing CLI handlers and enforcing ID invariants at store load is appropriate: every command benefits from validated data, while deleted IDs remain unused through `next_id`. A separate ID registry would add complexity without improving this file-backed workflow. The documented, contrived overlong zero-padded ID case remains deferred.
Files changed (8) +401 / -13

Enhancement (1) +78 / -10
cli.pyImplement done, remove, and completed-item listing +78/-10
>Implement done, remove, and completed-item listing > >
>• Adds idempotent completion, deletion, and list --all with [x] markers. Validates plain ASCII-digit IDs, treats dash-led arguments as IDs for done and remove, and reports unknown IDs consistently.
>
> >todo/cli.py
Bug fix (1) +14 / -1
store.pyPreserve fresh IDs and reject duplicate stored IDs +14/-1
>Preserve fresh IDs and reject duplicate stored IDs > >
>• Raises a loaded next_id above every stored ID, with a minimum of 1, to prevent reuse after hand edits. Rejects duplicate item IDs as unreadable store data.
>
> >todo/store.py
Tests (2) +216 / -2
test_cli.pyCover completion, removal, listing, and invalid IDs +153/-2
>Cover completion, removal, listing, and invalid IDs > >
>• Adds direct and subprocess tests for done, remove, list --all, and non-reused IDs. Exercises malformed, dash-led, help-like, and overlong IDs and their error messages.
>
> >tests/test_cli.py
test_store.pyTest store ID repair and duplicate rejection +63/-0
>Test store ID repair and duplicate rejection > >
>• Checks that low next_id values are repaired without lowering valid values. Verifies duplicate IDs fail on load and cannot produce a misleading successful removal.
>
> >tests/test_store.py
Documentation (4) +93 / -0
DISPOSITIONS.mdRecord cold-review finding dispositions +7/-0
>Record cold-review finding dispositions > >
>• Records the fixes and test evidence for invalid IDs, duplicate IDs, and overlong inputs. Notes the deferred zero-padded ID edge case.
>
> >reviews/cold/M2/DISPOSITIONS.md
round-1.mdDocument initial cold-review findings +25/-0
>Document initial cold-review findings > >
>• Documents initial ID parsing and duplicate-ID findings, acceptance-criteria coverage, and scope.
>
> >reviews/cold/M2/round-1.md
round-2.mdDocument follow-up review of ID handling +31/-0
>Document follow-up review of ID handling > >
>• Records the overlong-digit regression found after the ASCII-digit fix and verifies earlier fixes.
>
> >reviews/cold/M2/round-2.md
scoped-1.mdDocument scoped review of the overlong-ID fix +30/-0
>Document scoped review of the overlong-ID fix > >
>• Verifies the overlong-ID error handling and records the remaining zero-padded ID edge case.
>
> >reviews/cold/M2/scoped-1.md

### The AI Code Review Platform

## Get Started
Simply sign into Github and click the "Configure" button. Check out our documentation for more info: https://docs.qodo.ai/get-started.

## Overview
Qodo automatically reviews every GitHub pull request, identifies logic bugs, edge cases, security issues, and code quality problems, and provides actionable suggestions your team can apply immediately.

Install in minutes. Integrates seamlessly into your existing workflows.

## Qodo is designed for developers who:
- Handle frequent pull requests and need reliable review coverage
- Balance code quality with fast delivery
- Work in complex, multi-repo systems
- Use AI-generated code and need stronger guardrails
- Build production software where reliability matters

## Qodo Capabilities
- ## Automated PR Analysis
  - Reviews every pull request automatically
  - No manual trigger required

- ## Context-Aware Code Review
  - Understands cross-file changes
  - Detects architectural inconsistencies

- ## Actionable Suggestions
  - Concrete code fixes
  - Clear explanations
  - Prioritized feedback

- ## Security & Reliability Checks
  - Identifies risky patterns
  - Reduces attack surface area
